correctness.rationale: The independent exact-rational Fano chain reconstruction has 7 vertices, 21 edges, 28 independent triangles. Projection onto chords away from vertex 1 gives a 15x28 signed boundary A whose specified lexicographic 15x15 minor has determinant +1. The 13 remaining columns construct an integral 2-cycle basis. Signed action of g=(1 2 4 3 6 7 5) preserves the xor condition and yields Nw=0; the seven g-orbits of z plus six of w form a matrix of determinant -1. This proves Z[C7] direct sum augmentation ideal over Z, and coinvariants Z+Z/7, not merely a Q-character result.
